fichas.title: Perception of Colour
fichas.summary: Explains how colour affects mood, activity, perceived room proportions, and the visual prominence of architectural elements. It describes warm and cold colours, colour brightness and placement, the use of white, and surface-brightness values for colours and materials.
uses: Influence perceived room size and proportions
Create active, calming, or neutral atmospheres
Use white to separate and structure colour groups
Mark areas in warehouses and car parks
